title: openbao-config-mto-bootstrap values
description: Constrains only the switches whose values are consumed as string comparisons downstream, where a near-miss (yes / on / True / 1) would otherwise disable an integration silently. Everything else is intentionally unconstrained: this chart is wrapped by other charts and the schema must not become a second place to keep in sync. The accepted forms mirror templates/_helpers.tpl exactly -- a boolean, or the strings "true"/"false" so that --set-string and wrapper charts passing stringified values still work. If you change one, change the other.

boolish.description: true or false, as a YAML boolean or as the quoted string "true"/"false". Anything else (yes, on, off, 1, 0, True, TRUE) is rejected, because it would be read as "not enabled" without warning.

eso.description: A string, not a boolean: "enabled" or "disabled". true/false/yes/on are rejected.

mode.description: Drift protection. Unquoted on/yes/off parse as YAML booleans and are rejected -- quote the value.

safety.description: Deletion-policy posture for the platform-PKI CRs and (via the child Templates) every per-tenant CR. Cluster-global.

deletionProtection.description: true (default): retained on CR delete/rename; false: destroyed.

grantDeletionProtection.description: false (default): grants deleted on CR delete (revocation); true: grants retained.
